LUXSUM.Spawn.NoSourceActor: No source actor — assign a character to your user first.
LUXSUM.Spawn.NoActiveGm: No GM is connected. Summons are created by the GM's client, so one needs to be logged in — ask your GM to connect, then place again.
LUXSUM.Settings.MageHandTokenPath.Name: Mage Hand token art
LUXSUM.Settings.MageHandTokenPath.Hint: Optional override for Mage Hand's token and portrait — the module ships default art already. Accepts a static image or an animated .webm; leave blank to keep the shipped art.
LUXSUM.Settings.EnableVendoredOutline.Hi: Your Foundry build ships no outline effect, so this module draws its own. That custom effect is UNVERIFIED on real hardware and was responsible for summons rendering as invisible — leave it off unless you're testing it. If tokens vanish after enabling it, turn it back off and reload.
LUXSUM.Settings.CompanionDisposition.Hin: Disposition given to summoned companion tokens. Stat blocks from the system compendium are Hostile by default — this module sets them Friendly so they don't read as enemies to combat automation. Choose Neutral if your automation shouldn't sweep summons into "all allies" effects.
LUXSUM.Settings.ShowCompanionBar.Name: Show the Companion Bar
LUXSUM.Settings.ShowCompanionBar.Hint: A strip of portraits above the hotbar for switching between your character and your summons: click to select and pan, shift-click to add to your selection, double-click to open the sheet. Appears only when you have at least one companion.
LUXSUM.Bar.NoToken: {name} has no token on any scene.
LUXSUM.Keybind.Cycle.Name: Cycle through your companions
LUXSUM.Keybind.Cycle.Hint: Step to the next token in the Companion Bar — your character, then each summon in turn — selecting and panning to it.
LUXSUM.Keybind.SelectAll.Name: Select all your companions
LUXSUM.Keybind.SelectAll.Hint: Control every companion you own on this scene at once, so a pack (four skeletons, three mirror images) can be moved in a single drag.
LUXSUM.GmConsole.ForceNoFilters: Disable ALL token effects (outline, shimmer, motion) — world-wide
LUXSUM.GmConsole.TemplateMotionTooltip: Idle motion for every token of this template. Players' Restyle settings still apply beneath — this switch wins.
LUXSUM.GmConsole.ShowActiveOnly: Show only templates with active companions
LUXSUM.GmConsole.Empty: No active companions in this world. They'll appear here the moment someone summons.
LUXSUM.GmConsole.MotionFreeze: Freeze this companion's idle motion (GM override — wins over the owner's setting)
LUXSUM.GmConsole.MotionRestore: Restore this companion's idle motion (remove the GM override)
LUXSUM.GmConsole.DismissTooltip: Force-dismiss: death animation, then full token + actor cleanup
LUXSUM.Editor.Title: Templates
LUXSUM.Editor.Hint: Rename templates and variants, swap thumbnails, and link stat blocks. "Not linked" templates (the Summon spirit family) need you to paste the UUID of your imported stat block — right-click an actor in the sidebar → Copy UUID, or use a Compendium.… UUID. Changes apply immediately for everyone.
LUXSUM.Editor.TestLinkTooltip: Resolve this UUID and show which actor it points at
LUXSUM.Editor.LinkNotActor: Resolves, but not to an Actor
LUXSUM.Editor.LinkFailed: ✗ Could not resolve — check the UUID
LUXSUM.Editor.RemoveTooltip: Hide this variant from the picker (restorable)
LUXSUM.Editor.AddNeedsName: Give the new variant a name first.
LUXSUM.Editor.UnlinkedTooltip: This template's stat block hasn't been linked yet — paste your imported actor's UUID below.
LUXSUM.Editor.OverriddenTooltip: This template carries GM edits (stored in world settings — clear fields to revert).
LUXSUM.SettingsTab.YourSettingsHint: These affect only your own client — other players at the table are unchanged.
LUXSUM.SettingsTab.Hint: World options (art overrides, caps, anti-spam, approval mode) live in Foundry's settings sheet and are GM-controlled. GM motion and effect controls live in the All Companions tab.
LUXSUM.Picker.NotLinked: Not linked — the GM connects this stat block in Manager → Templates
